reference.title: Barbell Finger Curls
reference.listing: Video (title from the listing URL; the page could not be read from this environment, gymvisual.com is blocked by the proxy, so the movement is taken from the exercise name and standard coaching)

breathing.pattern: Breathe in as the bar rolls down, out as you curl it up.

prescription.tempo: Slow roll down, short hold, controlled curl, squeeze
prescription.load: Barbell load is user-chosen: light enough to hold at the fingertips without dropping it.

cues.text: Sit on the end of a bench, forearms along the thighs, palms up, wrists just past the knees, bar in a full fist about shoulder width.
Let the wrists bend back and open the fingers so the bar rolls down to the fingertips.
Hold the bar at the fingertips for a moment; do not let it slip.
Curl the fingers to roll the bar back into the palm, then curl the wrists up.
Squeeze the fist hard at the top.
Keep the forearms on the thighs for the next rep.

mistakes.mistake: Lifting the forearms off the thighs
mistakes.fix: Keep the forearms pinned; only the hands move.

mistakes.mistake: Letting the bar slip off the fingertips
mistakes.fix: Use a lighter bar and keep the fingertips hooked.
Pause at the fingertips before curling.
Open the hand fully, then close it fully.

kinematics.norm: Grip is strongest at about 35 degrees of wrist extension and needs at least 25 degrees (O'Driscoll 1992); the wrist bends back to let the bar roll out (clinical opinion)
Fingers open until the bar sits at the fingertips, then curl it back into a full fist (clinical opinion)
Forearms rest along the thighs and stay still; the wrists just past the knees so the hands move freely (clinical opinion)
Slow and controlled with a squeeze in the fist (clinical opinion)

cautions: Use a light bar: the fingertip position is a weak grip.
Wrist or finger pain, or a recent hand injury: use a band or skip.
Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
modify: Smaller range: roll only to the middle of the fingers.
progressions: Barbell seated wrist curl after the finger curl.

muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_r: The finger flexors let the bar roll out to the fingertips and curl it back into the palm; the wrist flexors finish the curl.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_l: The finger flexors let the bar roll out to the fingertips and curl it back into the palm; the wrist flexors finish the curl.
muscleNotes.biceps_r: Hold the elbows bent with the forearms on the thighs.
muscleNotes.biceps_l: Hold the elbows bent with the forearms on the thighs.
